Name: Bundle Highlighter and Item Encyclopedia
Author: soda5cm
Description:
[size=5][b]Bundle Highlighter & Item Encyclopedia[/b][/size]

Never wonder again "do I still need this for the Community Center?" — this mod highlights items you still need, tells you exactly where they go, and adds an in-game encyclopedia that explains where, when and how to get any item.

[b]Available in 12 languages[/b] — English, Русский, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, Português, Magyar, Türkçe, 日本語, 한국어, 中文.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[size=3][b]Bundle highlighting[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Items that are still needed for [b]Community Center bundles[/b] get a [b]gold frame[/b] in your inventory, chests, fridge, the bundle menu and the toolbar.[/*]
[*][b]Quality check[/b]: if a bundle needs gold quality and your item is lower, it gets a [b]red frame[/b] instead (can be turned off).[/*]
[*]Already donated slots and completed bundles are ignored automatically. Joja route is detected.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Museum highlighting[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Items that can still be [b]donated to Gunther[/b] get a [b]purple frame[/b]. Already donated items are not highlighted.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Smarter tooltips[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Hover an item to see [b]which bundle(s)[/b] need it, the room, the amount and the required quality.[/*]
[*]Museum items get a "can be donated" line.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Item Encyclopedia (press J)[/b][/size]
A JEI-style browser with all items, search, category tabs and a "only for bundles" filter. Hover any item to see:
[list]
[*]Description and sell price.[/*]
[*][b]Where and when to get it[/b], built from the game's own data: fishing spots, crab pots, foraging, crops, fruit trees, monster drops, shops (with prices), machines, crafting/cooking/tailoring recipes, geodes, artifact spots, garbage cans, animals and mining nodes.[/*]
[*][b]Live fishing chance "right now"[/b] — calculated by running the game's own fish-selection logic with the current time, weather, your fishing level, daily luck and the rod/bait in your hands.[/*]
[*][b]Fishing guide[/b]: season, time, weather, difficulty, which rods work (Training Rod limit), tackle tips, bait (Targeted/Magic bait) and required fishing level.[/*]
[*][b]Quality / stars[/b]: gold/silver chances for crops (with and without Deluxe Fertilizer) at your Farming level, forage quality at your Foraging level (Botanist), fruit tree quality by age.[/*]
[*][b]Luck[/b]: clearly says when luck does [b]not[/b] affect getting the item, and shows today's luck when it does.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu (in-game settings)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip the archive into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Controls & config[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]J[/b] — open the Item Encyclopedia.[/*]
[*][b]F7[/b] — toggle highlighting on/off.[/*]
[*]All colors, border thickness, fill opacity, pulsing, toolbar/menu/museum highlighting and tooltip lines can be changed in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] or Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Translations[/b][/size]
The mod is fully translated into [b]every language the game supports[/b]: English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hungarian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean and Chinese. The language switches automatically with the game language.
Spotted a translation that sounds off? Leave a comment — fixes are welcome ([font=Courier New]i18n[/font] folder).

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Works in single-player and multiplayer (bundle progress is read from the shared world state). Should be compatible with most mods; items added by other mods appear in the encyclopedia, with sources shown if they use the standard game data.

[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
Some sources are hard-coded inside the game and not in its data files (regular geode contents, mine nodes). For those the mod uses tables checked against the official Stardew Valley Wiki.

[i]Also on CurseForge.[/i]
